meta.syllabus: Salient features and classification of plants into major groups - Algae, Bryophytes, Pteridophytes, Gymnosperms and Angiosperms (three to five salient and distinguishing features and at least two examples of each category); Angiosperms - classification up to class, characteristic features and examples

head: System
Basis
Note
rows: Sirf kuch **vegetative characters** ya **androecium (stamens)** ki structure.
**Linnaeus** ka system. Related aur unrelated species ek saath aa jati thi.
**Natural affinities**: external + internal features (ultrastructure, anatomy, embryology, phytochemistry).
**Bentham and Hooker** ka system angiosperms ke liye.
**Evolutionary relationships**; common ancestry ke basis par.
Ab ye accept hota hai. **Numerical taxonomy**, **cytotaxonomy** aur **chemotaxonomy** bhi use hote hain.

items: **Chlorophyll-bearing, simple, thalloid, autotrophic**, mostly **aquatic** (fresh + marine). Fungi ke saath **lichens** banate hain.
**Form aur size:** microscopic **unicellular** (*Chlamydomonas*), **colonial** (*Volvox*), **filamentous** (*Ulothrix*, *Spirogyra*), aur kuch marine forms jaise **kelps** bahut bade.
**Vegetative reproduction: fragmentation.** **Asexual: zoospores.** **Sexual:** do gametes ke fusion se.

head: Sexual reproduction type
Gametes
Examples
rows: **Bada, non-motile female gamete** + **chhota, motile male gamete**.

items: Earth par **CO₂ fixation ka lagbhag aadha** photosynthesis se algae karte hain.
